name: Saint Markovia's Thighbone
description: The thighbone of Saint Markovia, with the properties of a Mace of Disruption. When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage. Once per day the wielder can call on its Disruption: a Fiend or Undead struck must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 25 Radiant damage; on a success it is Frightened until the end of the wielder's next turn. It sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for 20 more feet.

name: Staff of Power
description: A magic Quarterstaff with a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. While holding it you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws and spell attack rolls. It has 10 charges, all regained at dawn. Spells (your spell save DC), cost in charges: Cone of Cold 5, Fireball 5, Globe of Invulnerability 6, Hold Monster 5, Levitate 2, Lightning Bolt 5, Magic Missile 1, Ray of Enfeeblement 1, Wall of Force 5. Fireball and Lightning Bolt are cast at 3rd level.

name: Sunsword
description: The hilt of Sergei von Zarovich's blade, now a sentient sun blade (INT 11, WIS 17, CHA 16, chaotic good; it longs to destroy Strahd). Its blade of radiance is always on: a Longsword with the Finesse property, +2 to attack and damage rolls, dealing Radiant damage instead of Slashing. When you hit an Undead with it, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage. It sheds sunlight, Bright Light 15 ft and Dim Light 15 ft more.
